Where can savings earn more than 4%? | Post Office Schemes Explained

A post office savings account pays 4% a year. Its other government small-savings schemes pay more, for October–December 2026:
Senior Citizens Savings Scheme 8.2%, NSC 7.7%, Monthly Income Scheme 7.4%, PPF 7.1% (also: 5-year time deposit 7.5%, Sukanya Samriddhi 8.2%).
Illustrative: ₹10 lakh for a year at 8.2% earns about ₹82,000 of interest, vs about ₹40,000 at 4%. Each scheme has its own eligibility, lock-in and tax rules, and rates are reset every quarter.
